act_title: Shops and Commercial Establishments Acts (State Enactments, e.g., Telangana / Karnataka / Maharashtra)

sources.title: Notice of Termination of Service / Severance Pay
sources.summary: An employer cannot terminate an employee who has been in continuous employment for at least six months without giving at least one month's notice in writing or wages in lieu thereof, except in cases of proven misconduct. Gratuity and unpaid leaves must be settled.

sources.title: Daily/Weekly Hours and Overtime Wages
sources.summary: Normal working hours generally cannot exceed 8 to 9 hours a day or 48 hours a week. Any work performed beyond prescribed hours must be compensated at double the ordinary rate of wages (2x overtime).

sources.title: Earned Leave, Casual Leave, and Sick Leave
sources.summary: Employees are entitled to statutory annual earned/privilege leaves (usually 15 days), casual leaves (up to 12 days), and sick leaves, with statutory provisions for encashment upon resignation or termination.
